description: Core collectives built on point-to-point/transport, with reduction ops (SUM/PROD/MAX/MIN/LAND/LOR/...). MPICH collective algorithms (e.g. recursive-doubling allreduce, binomial bcast) translated.
title: mpi: collectives + reduction ops (barrier/bcast/reduce/allreduce/scatter/gather/allgather)

description: Add Taubin's two-pass lambda|mu smoothing on top of the discrete Laplacian: alternating positive (lambda) and negative (mu) explicit Laplacian passes to denoise without the volume shrinkage of plain Laplacian smoothing. Reuses laplacian edge weights.
title: outram-blender: Taubin (lambda|mu) shrinkage-free smoothing

description: Particle temperature integration; particle-particle and particle-wall heat transfer. Applications: pebble beds, TRISO fuel, packed beds, granular heat transfer. DoD: theory+verification+benchmark+uom.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Thermal DEM: particle/particle + particle/wall contact conduction (Batchelor & O'Brien) + temperature integration, energy-conserving. Clean-room. Foundation landed (commit e273ef2), unit-tested but NOT benchmark-validated (human DoD step pending) — stays in_progress.

title: Phase 4 — Thermal DEM
